scope: International and expatriate primary/secondary campuses in Kuala Lumpur, Putrajaya and Selangor. Primary subjects only, matching the application schema. No claim of exhaustive official registration coverage.
method: Captured every paginated result from EDM and MySchools for all three regions, plus the broader Kuala Lumpur International Schools Guide.
Reconciled each unique source profile to existing records, verified additions, explicit exclusions or an unresolved queue.

Verified new field values from official school/group/government sources. Shared programmes and recruitment channels are labelled; general emails are never classified as recruitment without explicit application instructions.
No map coordinates inferred for new campuses. No mailbox deliverability or live vacancy guarantee.

diagnosis.cause: Discovery coverage gap, not a demonstrated crawler rejection.
diagnosis.evidence: Spectrum is present in the captured discovery inventories. The prior directory had no retained candidate-to-campus reconciliation proving full source coverage. Subsequent reviews enriched known records, so undiscovered campuses could remain missing.
diagnosis.limits: No historical crawler request log establishes which earlier query, page limit or fetch failure caused the original omission. Those specific causes cannot be proved retrospectively.
diagnosis.prevention: Retain this inventory and one disposition per source profile; rerun collection and reconcile new or changed entries, including multi-campus groups and rebrands.

limitations: Unresolved candidates remain; this audit does not certify all operating campuses are covered.
Source pages may lag moves, closures and rebrands. National-school or learning-centre status needs separate verification when ambiguous.
Subject lists may be partial or shared across a school group; notes record scope. Empty subjects mean unverified or secondary-only, never inferred from Cambridge/IPC branding.
International Schools Database timed out and SchoolAdvisor regional results were not extractable; neither is counted as a reconciled source.
Existing records are matched for identity only unless explicitly noted; their prior field verification dates remain unchanged.
